channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Road Runners excel at Chester 10k and North Wales races
item.description: Five North Wales Road Runners were amongst a very large field of some 7,315 entrants at the Chester 10k race last Sunday, and they all performed well and recorded some noteworthy finishing times.

item.title: Hot pace at Rhos-on-Sea parkrun after frosty start for plenty of visitors
item.description: It was bright and sunny following a heavy early morning frost at the Llandrillo yn Rhos parkrun last Saturday, which also commemorated International Women’s Day.

item.title: Abergele school staff strike amid ‘culture of bullying and intimidation’
item.description: Staff at a school in Abergele have held industrial action “in protest of continuous bullying and intimidation”.

item.title: Met Office forecasts more snow for the UK this week - see exactly where and when
item.description: More snow has been forecast for parts of the UK this week by the Met Office - see exactly where and when to expect it.

item.title: Santander, Lloyds & more banks closing branches in coming weeks - full list
item.description: In total, 43 branches are set to close in the coming weeks, with Lloyds, the Bank of Scotland, and Santander closing branches in Spring

item.title: Conwy councillors resort to 'thumbs up or down' to vote on 6.5% council tax rise
item.description: Conwy County Council has released the recorded vote following councillors opting to up council tax by 6.5%.

item.title: Multiple ferries cancelled or delayed as disruption continues at Holyhead Port
item.description: Irish Ferries said its Ulysses sailing on Sunday, March 8 had been unable to berth at Holyhead at 11am (GMT) due to "extraordinary reasons".

item.title: Plans lodged to repair roof of Grade II listed Llandudno hotel after £500k revamp
item.description: Failure to undertake the repairs will result in water ingress, progressive decay of historic fabric and potential harm to the building's significance.

item.title: Craig-y-Don café run by mum and daughter secures five-star food hygiene
item.description: The partnership is certainly paying off, with the pair now earning a five-star food hygiene rating!

item.title: Llandudno hotel could host plays, boxing and wrestling 'should opportunities arise'
item.description: A seafront hotel in Llandudno could host plays, boxing, wrestling and other indoor sports "should opportunities arise in the future".
